_readme: Machine copy of the facts the scripts check machine-readable surfaces against. VOLATILE: re-verify against the sources below whenever 'verified' is older than 30 days, and update this file in the same session (rule: dont-hardcode-volatile-facts). Never let a script's default override the live policy.
sources: live Shopify shop.shopPolicies (Shipping Policy, Refund Policy)
true_trust_claims: free US + CA shipping, no minimum
pre-shipment QC inspection (Shipping Policy s1, Refund Policy s4)
replacement/refund for verified transit damage (Refund Policy s4, 48h photo report)

google_feed_wordlist._scope: Only the Google/Meta/Pinterest-synced fields: product title (= PDP H1), description, SEO title (= <title>), SEO description (= meta description), handle. Fine everywhere else (tags, collections, custom.* metafields, blog, pins, email). Source: CLAUDE.md PRODUCT POLICY GATE item 3.

forbidden_vocabulary._scope: PDP spec v2.0 s0.3 (all commercial copy). Source: 03-skills/Product Description Prompt v2.0 - Decoration That Heals.md

health_claim_patterns._scope: Layer B (commercial) never; Layer A (blog editorial) only hedged with a Science Bank source. Source: Brand_System_Decoration_That_Heals s3/s5.
